expression_comparison.chosen_because: AUDNZD is even more extreme in percentile terms but mixes two commodity FX regimes. CA-US 5Y is the cleaner fundamental valuation gap versus BoC/Fed evidence.

considered_rates.assessment: US 10Y 4.94 is near the 1y 97.8th percentile with a 45.000000000000014bp 3m change; AU 2Y 4.835 sits at the 99.8th 1y percentile while Australian housing is tightening.
US 2s10s is 27.000000000000046bp at the 1.4th 1y percentile, so curve is an executable alternative to spot or outright duration.
CA-US 5Y is -122.00000000000001bp at the 0.2th 1y percentile — a historically extreme cross-market RV object.

considered_spot.assessment: USDCAD can express the same gap but adds oil, risk and flow noise around a rates dislocation that is already quantified.

remit: historically or fundamentally mispriced currencies and convergence trades
stance_summary: CA-US 5Y at the 0.2nd 1y percentile is a cleaner valuation object than stretched FX crosses.
